requirements.description: Reject nonfinite, flat, multidimensional or shorter-than-10-second signals and sample rates outside 100 to 1000 Hz.
requirements.rationale: Do not silently process invalid ECG input.

requirements.description: Detect QRS peaks from channel 0 using XQRS without annotation input; achieve QRS sensitivity and PPV >=0.90 on each full demonstration record, and >=0.98 on the first minute of record 100.
requirements.rationale: A regression floor for this dataset subset, not a clinical acceptance criterion.

requirements.description: Compute RR mean, population CV and RMSSD; flag irregular only when CV >=0.12 and RMSSD/mean >=0.08.
requirements.rationale: Keep decisions explainable with timing features.

requirements.description: Return insufficient_data when fewer than 10 RR intervals exist or any RR is outside inclusive 0.25 to 2.5 s.
requirements.rationale: Missing or implausible timing must not become a regular result.

requirements.description: Use complete 30-second windows, exclude crossing RR intervals, and reject invalid peak indices.
requirements.rationale: Prevent duplicate beats, partial windows and unit mistakes.

requirements.description: Score only annotated beats with chronological one-to-one matching at inclusive 150 ms; report TP, FP, FN, sensitivity and PPV, with null for empty denominators.
requirements.rationale: Avoid inflated metrics from duplicate matches or rhythm events counted as beats.

requirements.description: Compare window flags with AFIB rhythm duration: positive >=80%, negative <=20%, otherwise excluded; unknown rhythm is excluded; report abstentions and conservative sensitivity counting positive abstentions as misses.
requirements.rationale: Separate a timing flag from a disease diagnosis and show abstention bias.

requirements.description: Allow only records 100, 201 and 203 from MIT-BIH 1.0.0; verify every header, signal and annotation SHA-256 before parsing; fail closed on corrupt downloads.
requirements.rationale: Keep the demonstration reproducible and avoid arbitrary private paths.

requirements.description: Label successful output as a learning exercise and not a cleared device; reject unsupported record IDs with nonzero exit and no new report.
requirements.rationale: Reduce foreseeable misuse and prevent a failed command appearing successful.

requirements.description: Fail traceability if a requirement or control lacks a test, names an absent test, lacks a requirement link, or its current JUnit test is not passing; generate the matrix only after validation.
requirements.rationale: Prevent documentary links from substituting for execution evidence.

requirements.description: Write per-record QRS and exploratory AFIB-proxy counts and rates, per-window features/status, abstentions, omitted duration, configuration and input hashes as strict JSON.
requirements.rationale: Regenerate every result and inspect false positives rather than a pooled headline.

risks.sequence: A beat is missed; RR variability is distorted; a reader interprets a regular flag as reassurance.
risks.initial_probability: Unknown; not estimated from three records

controls.description: Exercise QRS regression floors on independent annotations

risks.residual: 76 and 65 beats are missed on records 201 and 203 in the baseline. The flag cannot rule out disease.
risks.residual_review: Accepted for public offline education only. Unacceptable for clinical release; no patient use authorized.

risks.sequence: Ectopy or noise increases RR variation; the irregular flag is mistaken for an AFIB diagnosis.
risks.harm: Anxiety or unnecessary intervention if misused.
risks.initial_probability: Observed false-positive windows; clinical probability unknown

controls.description: Expose nonclinical warning and explicit learning-only output
Publish per-record false positives and AFIB-proxy limitations

risks.residual: Record 201 has 35 false-positive AFIB-proxy windows and 32.7% proxy PPV. There is no clinical benefit-risk justification.
risks.residual_review: Accepted for public offline education only. Unacceptable for clinical release; no patient use authorized.

risks.sequence: Wrong record, modified annotation or truncated download is processed as trusted data.
risks.harm: Misleading performance claims could support an unsafe downstream change.

controls.description: Restrict dataset and verify all input hashes before reading

risks.residual: Initial trusted manifest could be wrong and upstream annotations can contain error. Hashes establish consistency, not clinical truth.
risks.residual_review: Accepted for public offline education only. Unacceptable for clinical release; no patient use authorized.

risks.sequence: Too few or implausibly spaced beats produce a reassuring result; an abstention is excluded from sensitivity.

controls.description: Abstain on insufficient or implausible RR sequences
Count positive abstentions as misses in conservative sensitivity

risks.residual: Four AFIB-positive windows in record 203 abstain. Conservative sensitivity is 91.7%; finite noise and some artifacts can still produce plausible peaks.
risks.residual_review: Accepted for public offline education only. Unacceptable for clinical release; no patient use authorized.

risks.sequence: Duplicate matches, nonbeat annotations or mixed/unknown rhythm spans are mislabeled, inflating accuracy.
risks.harm: Unsafe reliance on misleading benchmark results.

controls.description: Enforce one-to-one beat scoring and exclude nonbeat events
Label by known rhythm duration and disclose exclusions

risks.residual: Three selected records are not representative. AFIB proxy labels do not measure general arrhythmia sensitivity; no clinical validation exists.
risks.residual_review: Accepted for public offline education only. Unacceptable for clinical release; no patient use authorized.

risks.sequence: A requirement or risk control changes without a verifying test, but the release appears complete.
risks.harm: Undetected regressions in a downstream medical use.

controls.description: Require collected and passed tests for every requirement/control

risks.residual: A passing test can have weak assertions. Human design review and broader validation remain necessary; the gate checks evidence completeness, not adequacy.
risks.residual_review: Accepted for public offline education only. Unacceptable for clinical release; no patient use authorized.
